title: pvClientServerMoveData
body:
## pvClientServerMoveData

ParaView-internal helper that copies data from the server's root process to the client in a client-server session; without a remote connection it is a pass-through filter. Because the receiving side must create its output before data arrive, the output type is fixed by OutputDataType (and image extent by WholeExtent) rather than taken from the input. It has no analysis value in a Schemaxis pipeline; use passArrays or no filter at all.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Keep OutputDataType equal to the input's VTK type id; the input is shallow-copied into an output of that type, so a mismatch gives incomplete or empty output.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ClientServerMoveData`. Identity: `filters/ClientServerMoveData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Client Server Move Data filter. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OutputDataType` | VTK data-object type id of the output, from vtkType.h: 0 polydata, 2 structured grid, 3 rectilinear grid, 4 unstructured grid, 6 image data. The filter creates an empty output of this type and copies the input into it, so it must match the input type. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `WholeExtent` | Whole extent [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax] (inclusive index bounds) announced for the output when the receiving process has no input of its own; it matters only for structured (image) outputs. With an input connected, the input's extent is used instead. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvClientServerMoveData",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
